Supreme Court to Examine Bar Council's Authority Over Legal Education

The Supreme Court of India has stated it will examine the extent of the Bar Council of India's (BCI) authority to regulate legal education. A bench observed that while the BCI might be able to set general guidelines, such as the duration of a law course, it may not have the power to dictate the specific details or nuances of legal education. The court questioned the BCI's knowledge of legal education when considering its regulatory powers.
